H1.why: The summary states 'the trial diet was not fed exclusively, and it is not a test of the diet alone', which carries both the trial_reading bottom line and the confounder scope words. It gives no off-list count, so no floor is read as a total.

H2.why: No sign is said to have improved, resolved or worsened, and no diet or drug is tied to any change. The vomiting counts and the trial sentence are not set up as cause and effect.

H3.why: The summary says nothing about refused or partly eaten meals, so none is softened.

H4.why: Nothing is presented as normal, stable or clear because of missing entries.

H5.why: The counts keep their qualifiers: 'in the last 7 days', and '12 of 45 logged days' as the logged-day denominator. The trial dates match the trial line.

H6.why: Every claim traces to the band or the record lines: the 6 entries in 7 days, the 16 entries on 12 of 45 days with the last on Oct 31, and the trial name, foods and dates.

H7.why: Sentence 1 states band item 1, the vomiting burden flag, with its numbers intact. No later sentence makes any band item sound calmer, smaller or older. Band items not mentioned print above the summary and are not themselves a hazard.
